$comment: Blind rater V, seed 702, production build on :5230, headed GPU driver at 400x800 3x. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, eval-fun FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3, the template, and the header of tools/driver.mjs (for the ops). No PLAN/research/CUT/source/other cards opened. Notes: scratchpad/raterV/notes.md; shots: scratchpad/raterV/shots/.

absences: simulated 8h via ?dev=1&absent=8h (loaded once, after ~37 min cold play); no real-time absence taken
horizon.$note: Every run was watched live, mostly in the default 'fights' mode (one run in 'fast'); ~40-110 s wall each. 16 own rule edits (conds, thresholds, verbs, reorders, a second cond on a row) plus 1 tapped patch. 4 deaths read (D6 archer, D6 fire potion, D7 gas, D9 ogre) plus the return screen's gas death. Audio: unassessed (never inspected window.__audio, could not hear).

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: My fighter kept banking at D8 until the return screen said 'R5 bank ended 7 runs, none past D8', so I pushed the bank to D10 and he got stuck under a Goblin Warlord's 'shields up' and ran home at 5 HP. That taught me 'counter: attack boss'; I swapped my never-fired drink-unknown row for 'foe: boss → attack boss', and the next run he dropped to 11 HP, drank, and the warlord went down. He walked into D9, 'the Fens', past eels and a pink jelly that split, and banked $244 on D10.

probes.clarity: Mostly: the forecast updated as I edited ('bank 0% · return 35% · death 65%'), but I could not parse 'R1 hazard first · R2 hazard first · … R7 hazard first' under death 3, 'The lock took him to 1 HP', or the reel's 'R1 drink heal caught him.' on a run he survived.
probes.decisions: Moving the bank from 'depth ≥ 5' ('bank 85% … ~$64') to 'depth ≥ 8' ('bank 29% · return 65% · death 6% · ~$95') is a push-or-bank choice I'd defend, and I made it again after the warlord, taking it to D10.
probes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know row order kills you. Now I know the drink-unknown row at R2 drank a fire potion at 7 HP before my return row could fire, and a gas-retreat at R1 kept retreating at 4 HP from an ogre.
probes.tension: I sweated at '4/38 … R1 · drink heal' on D6 with $211 carried and at 'Down to 2 HP. Returned with $87'. But most runs ended with the return rule pulling him out at D5–D6, so the outcome was rarely in doubt.
probes.feel: Fights read well at 1x ('ogre winds up', '−6 ogre', '−1 captain'), but name tags collide ('CAPTIMONKEY', 'CONJUREJACKAL') and there are 10-11 s stretches of nothing but 'pick up ×3 … pick up ×6'. Audio unassessed.
probes.surprise: The D8 Goblin Warlord was the wall behind 'D9 0% ±1', and past it the Fens (eels, 'pink jelly: splitter'). The pet I lost, Morak, came back as 'Morak the jackal, gone wild.' and my next hero killed him. Monkeys stealing gear showed up almost every run and stopped surprising me.
probes.expression: My set ended as 'hp<30 drink heal / foe: boss → attack boss / hp<25 return / depth≥10 bank / foe: heavy → attack heavy / foe: ranged → attack ranged / attack nearest'. It's mine, but I suspect most players would land near it.
probes.story: 'Morul the goblin archer is avenged.' came right after 'Found heir 1's bones: 12 items.' on the run where heir 3 banked $264 at D8. That and the warlord arc are stories I'd tell.
probes.pacing: In a run: 40–110 s at 1x, with dead pick-up stretches. Admin: every buy waits ~3.5 s for the forecast, and the cage 'choose one' sheet timed out before I could pick every time. Loop: send → read → edit → send was tight, and I wanted one more run often.
probes.failure: Every death named a cause, the rule and the gap: 'fire · D6 · gap / Gambled: fire potion.' with R2 drink unknown fired at 9 and 7 hp. Death 3's 'hazard first' footer and '· explore' at 3 hp were the exception.
probes.autonomy: I chose to tame ('foe: fast → tame nearest') at a forecast cost of ~$80→~$57 just to unlock '+1 party'. I also tried a ranger build, which the forecast talked me out of.
probes.progression: Within a run: L1→L4, D5→D10, cleave. Between runs: rows 4→7, vault, party slots, restock/keep automations, ranger. But ◆ dried up ('+1 row ◆11' with ◆0–1 after most returns) while money piled up with nothing to spend it on ($1488).
probes.aesthetic: The dark pixel dungeon and the chunky hero sprite are pleasant, and 'The air stings: bloats ahead.' has tone. The camp is a long monospace list of chips.
probes.return: I came back to '16 RUNS · 9 BANKED · 6 RETURNED · 1 DEATHS', 'PLATEAU / R5 bank ended 7 runs, none past D8', and 'R3 fired 0 of 16 runs: hp < 50% → drink unknown'. Both lines pointed at my own rows, and I acted on both. Unexplained: 'SPENT heal ×32 · −$1280'.
probes.attribution: 'I put the gas retreat above my heal, so he retreated at 4 HP from an ogre and died on D9 with $244'. Deaths 2 and 4 were mine and I can say which row. A tapped patch silently replaced my least-fired row, which was my D8 bank row.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: The first edit took under 2 min and every chip change reprices the forecast live. Misreads: 'R1 hazard first ×7' (death 3), 'The lock took him to 1 HP', 'R1 drink heal caught him.' on a survived run, header '◆+7' vs RENOWN '◆+3', 3 heals bought but 'SPENT heal ×1 · −$120'.

'depth ≥ 5 → bank' ('bank 85% … ~$64') vs 'depth ≥ 8' ('bank 29% · return 65% · death 6% · ~$95') were both defensible across runs, and so was curious+drink-unknown vs not. Lapse: money is a dominated resource (auto-restock spends it, $1488 idle), so shop choices stopped mattering.

I learned row priority, then two-cond rows, then the boss counter, and deepest went D6→D8→D10. Lapse: after the warlord, runs slid back to D5–D6 returns and nothing new was left to learn in the last 15 min.

'4/38 … R1 · drink heal' with $211 carried and 'Down to 2 HP. Returned with $87' were real sweats. But the return row made most runs a foregone D5–D6 homecoming, and the forecast's ± numbers drained the doubt.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: At 1x a fight ticks readably ('ogre winds up', '−6 ogre', hp bar), and the shots were smooth on the GPU. Name tags overlap ('CAPTIMONKEY', 'CONJUREJACKAL'), there are 10-11 s dead 'pick up ×N' stretches, and the cage sheet expired before I could tap. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: The warlord behind 'D9 0% ±1', the Fens (eels = water, pink jelly = splitter), my dead pets coming back 'gone wild', heir 1's bones. All of these changed my rules. Lapse: monkey thefts ('A thief snatched the …') in nearly every run became wallpaper.

My 7 rows are recognisably mine (boss counter, heavy counter, D10 bank), but the forecast steers toward one obvious set. The ranger was forecast-rejected at L1 ('~$19 · stall 9%'), so I never built a second identity.

'Found heir 1's bones' then 'Morul the goblin archer is avenged.' then 'Banked $264'. Plateau → warlord → 'Slew the Goblin Warlord.' → Fens. Lapse: tamed pets die as one line ('jackal Morak fell') in the first 16 s, so the bond that feeds 'gone wild' never lands.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 40–110 s, with dead pick-up stretches up to 11 s. Admin: ~3.5 s wait per purchase, the missed cage picks, and scrolling a very long unlock list. The whole loop still pulled me into another run most times.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Each death has cause · depth · gap, a 5-row trace with R-numbers, and priced patches ('survives 100% · base 25% · reach +25%'). Recovery is instant: a new heir and traits. Lapse: death 3 ended in '· explore' at 3 hp under 'R1..R7 hazard first', which I could not act on.
I set my own goals: a tame run to unlock party slots, a ranger experiment, pushing past D8. Route and floor order are the dungeon's, not mine.

Vocabulary grew with facts (attack heavy/gas/boss/splitter/water, drink strength…), plus rows 4→7, auto: restock and keep, party, ranger. But ◆ went dry after the first 20 min ('+1 row ◆11', ◆0 per return), and money stopped meaning anything ($1488, restock burned '−$1280').
Moody olive-brown pixel tiles, a good hero sprite, terse flavour ('A den. Something sleeps.', 'The air stings: bloats ahead.'). The camp is a utilitarian chip list. Audio not assessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: The 8 h return gave '16 RUNS · 9 BANKED · 6 RETURNED · 1 DEATHS', a PLATEAU line naming my R5, 'R3 fired 0 of 16 runs', hatched pets and trophies. It led straight to my best run. Lapse: 'SPENT heal ×32 · −$1280' ate 65% of the take with no explanation, and 'The lock took him…' reel lines were cryptic.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Deaths 2 (my drink-unknown outranking return) and 4 (my gas-retreat above heal) were first-person mine, and the boss win was mine. Lapse: tapping a patch silently removed my least-fired row (the D8 bank) and I only noticed by reading the list.

gripes: Money is meaningless and ◆ is a trickle: $1488 banked with nothing to buy, auto-restock quietly spent $1280 on heals (and kept re-buying a one-off bow), while '+1 row' needs ◆11 and returns pay ◆0.
Pets and cages don't let me care. Tamed or bought pets die as a one-liner in the first minute of most runs, and the 'choose one' cage sheet expires before I can tap it.

Some text is opaque exactly where it matters: 'R1 hazard first ×7' on a death, 'The lock took him to 1 HP', 'R1 retreat caught him.' on a run he survived. Also a patch that silently deletes one of my rows.
tellAFriend: You write a 7-line if-then list for a dungeon hero and watch it play out, and when he dies it shows the exact line that killed him. Usually the culprit is the line you were proud of.
The camp forecast re-simulates as you edit ('bank 29% · return 65% · death 6%'), so every tweak is a readable bet.
Leave it overnight and it tells you where you're stuck ('R5 bank ended 7 runs, none past D8'). Push past that and there's a boss, a new rule to learn and a new biome.
